chunks: In the help of God. He helps whom He will; He is all-mighty, ever-merciful.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God helps whom He wills?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine prerogative (Iradah) where God's victory is not bound by human metrics but by His wisdom and mercy, often linked to the concept of Tawhid in action. It reassures believers that true success (Nasr) is a spiritual and communal reality granted by Allah, reinforcing the idea that divine aid is contingent upon faith and righteousness rather than mere material strength.
